name: Veil — Privacy Mask for WhatsApp Web
description: Mask names, messages, media and notifications on WhatsApp Web. Zero network access: nothing ever leaves your browser.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

panic-lock.description: Lock WhatsApp Web behind the privacy curtain now

reveal-chat.description: Show / hide the open chat only (re-masks when you switch chats)

presenter-mode.description: Apply the Presenter preset (redact, aliases, no reveal)
